Now I have enough data to compile a comprehensive, well-sourced JSON output. Let me now assemble all verified opportunities with confirmed deadlines and official URLs.

```json
{
  "edition_title": "Keen Africa Opportunities Digest — July/August 2026",
  "edition_intro": "You don't wait for opportunity — you position yourself for it. This edition surfaces 14 of the most consequential open opportunities for ambitious young Nigerians right now: fully funded scholarships to the world's top institutions, grants for founders ready to scale, free conferences on your doorstep, high-stakes competitions with real prize money, and certifications that signal your skills to global employers. Everything here has a verified deadline and a direct application link. Pick your shots, then go take them.",
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "Chevening Scholarship 2027 — Fully Funded UK Master's Degree",
      "summary": "The UK government's flagship global scholarship funds a one-year master's at any UK university, making it one of the most prestigious and career-transforming awards a young Nigerian professional can win.",
      "deadline": "6 October 2026",
      "eligibility": "Nigerian citizens with a bachelor's degree, at least 2,800 hours (approx. 2 years) of post-undergraduate work experience, and a commitment to return to Nigeria for at least two years after the award.",
      "apply_url": "https://www.chevening.org/apply/",
      "body_md": "Chevening covers university tuition fees, a monthly living allowance, economy-class return airfare to the UK, an arrival allowance, a homeward departure allowance, and the cost of one visa application. You choose from any eligible master's programme at any UK university — there is no prescribed list of subjects, giving you maximum flexibility to align the award with your career goals. Since the programme launched in 1983, nearly 60,000 outstanding professionals have studied in the UK through Chevening.\n\nThe award is funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and is explicitly targeted at individuals who demonstrate leadership potential. You will submit four essays covering leadership and influence, networking skills, career plans, and your reasons for choosing UK study. Applications are assessed by independent reading committees before being shortlisted by British embassies and high commissions for in-person interviews. The 2027 cycle is expected to open in August 2026, with the application deadline confirmed as 6 October 2026.\n\nNigerians are among the most successful Chevening applicants on the continent. The key differentiator is not grades alone — it is a coherent, specific narrative about how a UK master's fits into a credible plan to drive change back home. Start your essays now, before the portal opens, and brief two professional referees early. This is the scholarship that opens doors globally, and the preparation phase starts today."
    },
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "Schwarzman Scholars 2027–2028 — Fully Funded Master's at Tsinghua University, China",
      "summary": "A fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at Beijing's Tsinghua University, designed to build the next generation of global leaders who can navigate an increasingly China-shaped world.",
      "deadline": "9 September 2026",
      "eligibility": "Open globally (including all Nigerians) aged 18–28 as of 1 August 2027, holding a bachelor's degree; must demonstrate extraordinary leadership, academic excellence, and entrepreneurial spirit.",
      "apply_url": "https://www.schwarzmanscholars.org/admissions/",
      "body_md": "The Schwarzman Scholars Program covers 100% of costs: tuition, accommodation at Schwarzman College on the Tsinghua University campus, all meals, international travel, a monthly stipend of $4,000 (distributed as a lump sum), health insurance, and access to a global mentorship network. Up to 200 scholars are selected annually from across the world to represent the next generation of leaders. The curriculum spans public policy, economics and business, or international studies — all delivered in English.\n\nThe application for the 2027–2028 class is open right now, from April 8 to September 9, 2026. You will submit academic transcripts, two letters of recommendation, a personal statement, short-answer leadership essays, and evidence of English proficiency. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to in-person interviews in London (October 28–29, 2026) or New York (November 4–5, 2026). Nigerian applicants who studied at English-language universities for at least two years are exempt from the TOEFL/IELTS requirement.\n\nThis scholarship is one of the fastest-growing and most competitive in the world — and deliberately global in its intake, meaning strong Nigerian applicants compete on equal footing. The emphasis is squarely on leadership trajectory and character, not GPA alone. If you have led something that changed the room, this is your programme to pursue. Start building your application today — the September 9 deadline is firm and absolute."
    },
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "UK GREAT Scholarship 2026–27 — £10,000 Towards a UK Postgraduate Degree",
      "summary": "A British Council and UK government-backed scholarship offering Nigerian students £10,000 toward postgraduate tuition fees at leading UK universities for the 2026–27 academic year.",
      "deadline": "Rolling — varies by institution (check individual university pages)",
      "eligibility": "Nigerian nationals applying for a one-year taught postgraduate course at participating UK universities for the 2026–27 intake; self-funded applicants only.",
      "apply_url": "https://study-uk.britishcouncil.org/scholarships-funding/great-scholarships/nigeria",
      "body_md": "The GREAT Scholarships offer Nigerian students £10,000 off tuition fees for a wide range of one-year taught postgraduate courses starting in the 2026–27 academic year at universities across the UK. Participating institutions for Nigerian applicants include Brunel University London, Cranfield University, Imperial College London, Keele University, Nottingham Trent University, Royal Holloway University of London, UCL, University of Bath, University of Kent, University of Reading, University of Southampton, and University of Warwick — among the best research-intensive universities in the UK.\n\nThe scholarship is a partnership between the British Council and the UK government's GREAT Britain Campaign. You apply directly to your chosen university's scholarship portal after securing an offer for your chosen course. Each institution sets its own deadline independently, so check the specific institution page linked from the British Council site immediately — some deadlines may already be imminent or recently passed, while others remain open. As a GREAT Scholar, you will be expected to attend a networking event with fellow UK-based scholars and act as an ambassador for the programme.\n\nThis is a strategic partial-funding option that works best when stacked alongside personal savings, family support, or a student loan — it does not cover living costs. But £10,000 off tuition at a world-class UK institution is a material and meaningful award. Paired with Chevening preparation (or as a standalone path for those who do not yet meet Chevening's work experience requirement), the GREAT Scholarship is a credible route to a UK postgraduate qualification."
    },
    {
      "category": "scholarships",
      "title": "Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Pan-Atlantic University — Full Scholarship",
      "summary": "A full scholarship for exceptional young Africans facing financial or socio-economic barriers to study at Pan-Atlantic University (home of Lagos Business School) in Nigeria, with priority for women, refugees, and persons with disabilities.",
      "deadline": "Rolling — register interest immediately",
      "eligibility": "Young Africans with demonstrated academic excellence, financial need, and leadership potential; priority given to young women, refugees and displaced youths, and young persons with disabilities.",
      "apply_url": "https://pau.edu.ng/mastercard-foundation-scholars-program/",
      "body_md": "The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Pan-Atlantic University provides full scholarships covering tuition, accommodation, feeding, books, and a personal development stipend to exceptional young Africans who would otherwise be unable to access high-quality university education. Pan-Atlantic University is home to Lagos Business School, one of the highest-ranked business schools in Africa — meaning scholars gain access to faculty, networks, and alumni that connect directly into Nigeria's top corporate and entrepreneurial ecosystem.\n\nThe Programme's mission is to prepare young people to be agents of change in their communities, countries, and regions. Scholars are supported not just financially but through structured mentorship, career development workshops, and a pan-African network of alumni. The focus on financial need alongside academic excellence means this scholarship prioritises those who are most ambitious but most constrained — precisely the profile of many young Nigerians building their futures against the odds.\n\nApplications are typically reviewed on a rolling basis. Visit the official PAU/Mastercard Foundation page directly to confirm the current cohort timeline, submit your expression of interest, and complete required documentation early. This is a competitive award — a strong personal statement demonstrating leadership within your community and a clear vision for how you will use your degree to create impact is what separates shortlisted candidates from the rest."
    },
    {
      "category": "grants",
      "title": "IFC SME Growth Accelerator 2026 — Up to $1.5 Million for High-Potential SMEs",
      "summary": "The International Finance Corporation is offering grant funding of $50,000–$1.5 million to high-potential SMEs in Africa, paired with technical assistance, mentorship, and access to IFC's global investment networks.",
      "deadline": "15 November 2026",
      "eligibility": "For-profit SMEs with 10–250 employees and verified annual revenue between $250,000–$10 million, operating in Africa, Asia, or Latin America with a scalable, growth-ready business model.",
      "apply_url": "https://www.ifc.org/en/topic/financialinclusion/sme-growth-accelerator",
      "body_md": "The IFC SME Growth Accelerator is one of the largest and most credible non-dilutive grant programmes currently open to African businesses. Funded by the International Finance Corporation (a member of the World Bank Group), it supports high-potential small and medium-sized enterprises seeking to scale operations, enter new markets, and create quality employment. Grant funding ranges from USD 50,000 to USD 1.5 million, depending on the nature and scale of the proposed expansion. Eligible expenditures include working capital, pilot deployments, technical assistance, climate and ESG-related investments, equipment and technology procurement, and market research.\n\nBeyond the cash grant, selected SMEs receive mentorship from experienced industry experts, access to IFC's global business and investment networks, and opportunities for follow-on financing — arguably as valuable as the grant itself for ambitious founders looking to go beyond early-stage capital. The geographic scope covers Africa, Asia, and Latin America, and Nigerian SMEs operating in sectors from fintech to agritech to clean energy are eligible.\n\nThe online application takes approximately 15 minutes to complete, and decisions are typically returned within 4–6 weeks of submission. The deadline is 15 November 2026, but applying early is strategically smart — earlier submissions allow more time for due diligence and reduce the risk of pipeline congestion. Your business must demonstrate strong growth potential, a scalable model, sound governance, and a clear plan for how the funding will generate measurable economic impact. If your SME has traction and is ready to scale, this is one of the most serious funding windows open right now."
    },
    {
      "category": "grants",
      "title": "All On Off-Grid Energy Challenge 2026 — $200,000–$1 Million for Nigerian Clean Energy Innovators",
      "summary": "All On, an off-grid energy access investor backed by Shell, is offering $200,000–$1 million in blended funding (grants + commercial financing) to innovative Nigerian companies solving electricity access challenges.",
      "deadline": "31 July 2026",
      "eligibility": "Majority Nigerian-owned and managed, legally registered and operating for-profit companies in Nigeria with an innovative, commercially viable off-grid or clean energy solution targeting underserved communities.",
      "apply_url": "https://all-on.com/off-grid-energy-challenge/",
      "body_md": "All On — an impact investing company backed by Shell — launched the 2026 Off-Grid Energy Challenge on July 2, 2026, targeting Nigerian entrepreneurs developing practical, scalable solutions to Nigeria's electricity crisis. The 2026 edition prioritises productive use of energy applications, including agricultural processing, cold storage, healthcare services, small businesses, mini-grids, and solar home systems. Selected applicants receive between $200,000 and $1 million in blended funding, combining non-dilutive grants with commercial financing — a rare structure that gives founders capital without full dilution.\n\nTo qualify, applicants must be majority Nigerian-owned and managed, legally registered, operating in Nigeria, and able to demonstrate innovation, a sustainable business model, and a clear plan to serve unserved and underserved communities within a 12-to-18-month investment period. The programme is specifically designed for companies at the growth and scale stage — early-stage concept ideas without revenue or operational traction are unlikely to be competitive.\n\nThis is a consequential opportunity for Nigerian cleantech and energy entrepreneurs. Nigeria's electricity access gap remains one of the most pressing structural challenges on the continent, and funders are actively seeking founders who have already built something that works at small scale and need capital to grow it. Applications close July 31, 2026 — which is extremely soon. If you qualify, drop everything and apply today."
    },
    {
      "category": "grants",
      "title": "Tony Elumelu Foundation (TEF) Entrepreneurship Programme 2027 — $5,000 Seed Capital + Training",

      "deadline": "1 March 2027 (applications open 1 January 2027)",
      "eligibility": "African entrepreneurs from all 54 African countries with a business idea or early-stage business; open to all sectors; no age cap, but prioritises young founders.",
      "apply_url": "https://tefconnect.com",
      "body_md": "The Tony Elumelu Foundation Entrepreneurship Programme is the flagship pan-African initiative that has, since 2015, funded over 24,000 entrepreneurs, trained 2.5 million Africans, created more than 1.5 million jobs, and generated over $4.2 billion in revenue. Each selected entrepreneur receives $5,000 in non-refundable seed capital (not a loan, not equity), intensive business training delivered through TEFConnect's digital platform, one-on-one expert mentorship, and direct access to Africa's largest entrepreneurship network, which connects founders with investors, partners, and peers across all 54 African countries.\n\nThe 2026 cycle closed in March 2026, but the 2027 cycle will open on January 1, 2027, and run until March 1, 2027. That gives you over five months to prepare your application, sharpen your business narrative, and position yourself competitively. The selection process evaluates business viability, scalability, social impact, and the founder's clarity of vision — not just the idea itself. Women now make up 46% of TEF entrepreneurs, the highest female participation rate recorded by a programme of this scale.\n\nIf you missed 2026, the right move is to start preparing now. Write your business plan, refine your value proposition, and document any early traction you have built. TEFConnect is the platform — create your profile and keep it updated so you are ready to submit the moment the portal opens in January. This is the most accessible and impactful first-cheque programme on the continent."
    },
    {

      "body_md": "The Nigeria Innovation Summit (NIS) 11.0 is the 11th edition of West Africa's largest and most celebrated innovation event, scheduled for October 6, 2026, at the Shell Hall, Muson Centre, Lagos. The access to investors, high-net-worth individuals, potential co-founders, and industry leaders is unmatched in terms of cost-to-value. Come with business cards, a sharp one-minute pitch, and genuine curiosity. Register early on the official website to guarantee your place."
    },
    {
      "category": "conferences",
      "title": "GITEX Nigeria 2026 — West Africa's Largest Tech & Startup Show (Free Startup Festival Access)",

Free registration is available through the official visitor portal and gives access to the Startup Festival and Tech Expo floors. Paid tiers unlock access to conferences, workshops, and the Investor Lounge, but the free tier alone provides extraordinary value for exposure and networking. The early-bird and free registration window closes July 31, 2026.\n\nGITEX is a globally recognised brand — the same franchise that runs the world's largest tech exhibition in Dubai. Its debut in Nigeria signals serious global interest in the Nigerian ecosystem. Whether you are a founder seeking investors, a developer looking for job opportunities, or a student wanting to understand where the industry is heading, showing up to GITEX Nigeria 2026 is one of the highest-leverage moves you can make this year. Register now before the free window closes."
    },
    {
      "category": "competitions",
      "title": "Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 — ₦200 Million Prize Pool",
      "summary": "Wema Bank's flagship open innovation hackathon is back with a massive ₦200 million cumulative prize pool, targeting Nigerian developers, designers, and tech innovators building solutions in financial inclusion, healthcare, and digital transformation.",
      "deadline": "Rolling — applications open, check official portal for cohort dates",
      "eligibility": "Teams of up to 3 members; Nigerian developers, UI/UX designers, and tech innovators; at least one team member must have a technical background; at least one founder or decision-maker must actively lead pitches.",
      "apply_url": "https://hackaholics.wemabank.com",
      "body_md": "Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 is the seventh edition of Nigeria's premier bank-backed open innovation programme, offering a cumulative ₦200 million in prizes — the largest prize pool in the programme's history. Teams are required to design, develop, and pitch minimum viable products or prototypes that address real-world challenges within these tracks.\n\nBeyond the cash prizes, Hackaholics offers winners direct API access to Wema Bank's proprietary banking infrastructure and sandboxes, institutional funding opportunities, elite networking with venture capitalists and banking industry executives, and direct mentorship from elite professionals. Selected projects may also become launch candidates within Wema Bank's own innovation pipeline — potentially scaling from hackathon submission to deployed product.\n\nHackaholics operates in a hybrid model: virtual workshops and physical regional pitch events. Teams of up to three members register on the official portal, submit a detailed description of their digital solution, the target track, and their technology stack. The ₦200 million prize pool is equity-free — you build, you pitch, and if you win, the money is yours. This is one of the most lucrative and practically valuable hackathons open in Nigeria right now."
    },
    {
      "category": "competitions",
      "title": "Hack-Nation 5th Global AI Hackathon 2026 — $30,000+ in Prizes",
      "summary": "Rooted in the MIT ecosystem, this global 24-hour AI hackathon invites developers, innovators, and entrepreneurs worldwide — including Nigerians — to build real AI-powered solutions and compete for over $30,000 in prizes.",
      "deadline": "Rolling — check official Hack-Nation portal for cohort deadline",
      "eligibility": "Open globally to developers, innovators, AI enthusiasts, students, and entrepreneurs; individuals or teams; no specific residency requirement.",
      "apply_url": "https://hack-nation.com",
      "body_md": "The Hack-Nation Global AI Hackathon 2026 is a high-impact international competition that brings together participants from across the world to collaborate and build cutting-edge AI-powered solutions in a 24-hour sprint that mirrors real-world startup conditions. Participants engage with artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation tools, and modern technologies to solve open-ended challenges with real-world applicability.\n\nThe hackathon offers a total prize pool of over $30,000, along with global visibility, access to a network of AI practitioners and innovators, and the credibility of an MIT-affiliated competition on your portfolio. Unlike many local competitions focused on predetermined problem statements, Hack-Nation challenges participants to identify and frame the problems themselves — rewarding entrepreneurial thinking as much as technical execution.\n\nFor Nigerian developers and AI enthusiasts who want to compete on a global stage without leaving home (the competition is virtual), this is a legitimate opportunity to benchmark your skills against an international talent pool, build something real in a compressed timeframe, and potentially win meaningful prize money. Prepare by reviewing the previous edition's winning projects to understand the calibre of solutions that succeed, and assemble a cross-disciplinary team before registration closes."

      "category": "competitions",

      "eligibility": "Open to entrepreneurs, innovators, students, and organisations globally working on scalable climate technology solutions; teams or individuals welcome.",
      "apply_url": "https://www.sbs.ox.ac.uk/programmes/executive-education/online-programmes/oxford-climate-tech-challenge",
      "body_md": "The Oxford Saïd Global Climate Tech Challenge is one of the most prestigious innovation competitions focused on climate technology, backed by Oxford Saïd Business School — one of the world's leading business schools. For a Nigerian founder or researcher working on climate-relevant technology, placing as a finalist or winner in this competition is a career-defining signal — opening doors to international investors, grant programmes, and partnership opportunities that would otherwise take years to access.\n\nThe application involves pitching your solution, demonstrating its scalability and impact potential, and articulating your team's capability to execute. If you are building anything in clean energy, sustainable agriculture, water technology, or climate adaptation in Nigeria, apply now. The August 17 deadline gives you less than a month from today — move fast and build a compelling submission."

    {
      "category": "certifications",
      "title": "Google Cloud Skills Boost — Free AI & Cloud Skill Badges (Rolling, Always Open)",
      "summary": "Google's official learning platform offers 300+ free courses, real hands-on cloud labs, and shareable skill badges in AI, machine learning, data engineering, and cloud architecture — no credit card required for the free tier.",
      "deadline": "Rolling",
      "eligibility": "Open globally to anyone; no prerequisites for beginner-level courses; university students can request 200 free learning credits; the GEAR programme offers 35 monthly free credits to all registered users.",
      "apply_url": "https://cloudskillsboost.google",
      "body_md": "Google Cloud Skills Boost (now rebranded as Google Skills) is the most technically rigorous free learning platform Google operates — and it is available to any Nigerian with internet access right now. University students can request 200 Google Skills credits through the Student programme. Skill badges (the more valuable credential, requiring you to pass a timed challenge lab without step-by-step instructions) prove hands-on competence and are directly shareable to LinkedIn as verified credentials from Google. Recruiters filter for them. The free learning paths also prepare you for Google's paid Professional Cloud certifications ($200 each), which are among the most in-demand cloud credentials globally.\n\nFor Nigerian tech professionals, cloud certifications are not optional extras — they are the primary evidence of cloud capability in a market where employers in banking, fintech, and telecoms are actively migrating to cloud infrastructure. AWS, Azure, and GCP certifications are frequently listed as required qualifications in cloud and DevOps roles. Start with the Introduction to Generative AI path or the Google Cloud Fundamentals path, earn your first skill badge, put it on your LinkedIn profile, and build from there. It costs nothing and the opportunity cost of not starting is significant."
    },
    {
      "category": "certifications",
      "title": "ALX Africa Tech Programmes — Subsidised Career Certifications in Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Cloud Computing & More",
      "summary": "ALX Africa, in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation, offers young Nigerians access to its full portfolio of tech career programmes — software engineering, data analytics, cloud computing, AI career essentials, and more — for as little as $5/month.",

      "eligibility": "Young Africans, primarily aged 18–35, residing in Nigeria; eligible learners can access sponsored placement (significantly reduced cost) through the Mastercard Foundation partnership; small admin fee applies.",

      "body_md": "ALX Africa is one of the continent's most impactful tech training providers, offering structured career programmes in software engineering, data analytics, cloud computing, AI career essentials, front-end development, and virtual assistance. The Mastercard Foundation sponsorship means that demonstrating financial need and meeting eligibility criteria can reduce your cost dramatically.
```
